challenges.requirement: 重复台词跨场景：保留每次事件，比较角色声音实例、说话节奏和实际情绪；不得复制第一次音频后无视第二次表演。
参考稿可能把屏幕文字和人物声音合并；依据实际画面与声音拆分事件，分别确定字幕与是否发声。
相同质问的两次不同回应：保留否认、转折、承认或辩解的方向；不要自动套用首次回答。
短句中的自我修正与现场指令：压缩译文仍须保留修正关系及对象，声源不能由当前镜头人物直接代替。
状态播报链：逐次保留不同阶段、数字和完成性，声线稳定且区别于现场人物。
跨段免责表达和后置限定：保留作用范围，不能把后置短句当无意义填充或遗漏。
短答、打断、停顿和随后反应：每次应答分别归属，保留事件间停顿，不擅自补全未完成语句。
压力升级、剩余时间和中止指令：数字/命令对象不变，手机版本仍可辨识，勿以音效覆盖关键短句。

audio_contract.effects_formula: effects_track = input/music_effects.wav * 10 ** (effects_gain_db / 20); no shifting, ducking, EQ, splicing, time stretching, or replacement
audio_contract.mix_formula: mix.wav = effects_track.wav + sum(all final-gain speaker tracks); no post-sum processing
audio_contract.mobile_formula: 0.5*(mix.left+mix.right), followed only by declared global gain and peak limiter; no content edits

subtitle_contract.note: Unicode non-whitespace code points; punctuation counts; speech cues must intersect corresponding plan event. Very short original interjections may last 0.2-0.4 s if source duration is similarly short and documented.
subtitle_contract.burn_in_region: bottom 32 percent of frame; both ZH and EN visible

reference_policy: S001-S073 are occurrence identifiers, not normalized text keys. Every source ID must be accounted for; one ID may split into speech/screen_text/non_speech events. No narration of screen text. Native cries may be recreated, never drop an event silently.
